name: PCSX AwO
author: Rinnegatamante
description:
PCSX AwO (ARMed with Octane) is a fork of PCSX ReARMed specifically tailored for PSVita, featuring a ultra optimized new renderer derived from Crash Team Racing: High Octane.
It features native Vita internal resolution, MSAA 4x, frame generation, post-processing shaders and many more features.
